AJG Welding

Coded welding. No shortcuts.

AJG Welding is Aidan Gething, a coded pipe welder working TIG and stick on stainless and carbon steel. Most days that means hospital plant rooms, boiler houses and heat exchangers, hot water and heating systems on planned shutdowns, gas and utility pipework, and stainless flanges and spools made up in the workshop.
